body.statement: Proposition 29 of ManoleBalakrishnanNilesWeedWasserman2023CLT supplies the two-dimensional pointwise periodized-KDE optimal-transport Gaussian conclusion in the fixed-source uniform-to-uniform case; it does not establish the general variable-coefficient or generated-target case.

source.verbatim_statement: Assume that $P$ and $Q$ are equal to the uniform measure $\calL$ over $\bbT^2$. Let $K \in \calC_c^\infty(\bbR^2)$ be a symmetric kernel that integrates to unity, and whose first moment vanishes. Assume further that $h_n\downarrow 0$ is a decreasing sequence of nonnegative real numbers such that $h_n \gg n^{-\frac 1 6}$. Then, for any fixed $x \in \bbT^2$, it holds that $$\sqrt{\frac{n}{\log(1/h_n)}} \big( \hat T_n(x) - x\big) \overset{w}{\longrightarrow} N\left(0, \frac {I_2} {4\pi} \right),\quad \text{as } n \to \infty.$$

attestation.note: Verified against the primary arXiv 2312.12407 source archive, manuscript_arxiv.tex, Proposition labeled prop:clt_map_2d in the two-dimensional discussion; adjacent text states general d=2 remains open except this uniform-torus case.
